    y_anchor = (right_beams[1].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], right_beams[0], (x_right, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle beam to upper right beam
    upper_right_beam = right_beams[1]
    anchor_y = (middle_beam.position.y + upper_right_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, upper_right_beam, ((x_middle + x_right)/2, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Cross-bracing for stability
    # Lower left to lower right
    lower_left_beam = left_beams[0]
    lower_right_beam = right_beams[0]
    anchor_y = (lower_left_beam.position.y + lower_right_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(lower_left_beam, lower_right_beam, ((x_left + x_right)/2, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Middle left to lower right
    middle_left_beam = left_beams[3]  # y=4.0
    anchor_y = (middle_left_beam.position.y + lower_right_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_left_beam, lower_right_beam, ((x_left + x_right)/2, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
